cards.ex: The two runners were neck and neck right up to the finish line.
cards.exUz: Ikki yuguruvchi finish chizig'igacha yonma-yon kelishdi.
cards.uzDef: Musobaqada juda yaqin, deyarli bir xil natija ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field so everyone has a fair chance.
cards.exUz: Biz hammaga adolatli imkoniyat berish uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar ta'minlangan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Our team blew the competition away in the final round.
cards.exUz: Bizning jamoa final raundida raqiblardan ustun keldi.
cards.uzDef: Musobaqada boshqalardan ancha ustun bo'lish, osongina yutish.

cards.ex: She really rose to the occasion and won the race.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatan ham vaziyatga moslashdi va poygada g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan vaziyatda o'zini ko'rsatib, yaxshi natijaga erishish.

cards.ex: That was a close call! I almost fell off the bike.
cards.exUz: Bu xavfli vaziyat edi! Men deyarli velosipeddan yiqilib tushdim.
cards.uzDef: Yaqinda yomon hodisa yuz berishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: He set a new world record in the 100-meter sprint.
cards.exUz: U 100 metrga yugurishda yangi jahon rekordini o'rnatdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi eng yuqori natijaga erishish.

cards.ex: That new strategy was a real game changer for the team.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi strategiya jamoa uchun haqiqiy o'zgarish sababchisi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tubdan o'zgartiradigan narsa yoki shaxs.

cards.ex: She took the lead in the second lap and never looked back.
cards.exUz: U ikkinchi aylanada oldinga o'tib, orqasiga qaramadi.
cards.uzDef: Musobaqada boshqalardan oldinga o'tib, birinchi o'rinda bo'lish.

cards.ex: You need to stay on top of your training schedule to improve.
cards.exUz: Yaxshilash uchun mashg'ulot jadvalingizni nazorat qilib turishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni nazorat ostida ushlab turish.

cards.ex: Everyone was surprised when the underdog won the championship.
cards.exUz: Ojiz tomon chempionatda g'alaba qozonganida hamma hayron qoldi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonishi kutilmaydigan shaxs yoki jamoa.

cards.ex: I'm really out of shape; I need to start exercising again.
cards.exUz: Men haqiqatan ham formada emasman; yana mashq qilishni boshlashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holati yaxshi bo'lmagan.

cards.ex: I'm trying to get into shape for the marathon.
cards.exUz: Men marafon uchun formaga kirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holatini yaxshilash, sport bilan shug'ullanish.

cards.ex: He was on the sidelines because of an injury.
cards.exUz: U jarohati tufayli chetda edi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealarga bevosita aralashmasdan, kuzatuvchi sifatida qatnashish.

cards.ex: The coach calls the shots on the team's strategy.
cards.exUz: Murabbiy jamoaning strategiyasi bo'yicha qarorlar qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qarorlar qabul qilish, boshqaruvda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Just give it your all, and you might surprise yourself.
cards.exUz: Faqat borini ber, va o'zingni ajablantirishing mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Butun kuchini sarflash, maksimal darajada harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Winning three gold medals is a tough act to follow.
cards.exUz: Uchta oltin medalni yutish - bu qiyin vazifa.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir muvaffaqiyatidan keyin bir xil yoki undan yaxshiroq natijaga erishish qiyinligi.

cards.ex: I was going to sign up, but someone beat me to it.
cards.exUz: Men ro'yxatdan o'tmoqchi edim, lekin kimdir mendan oldinroq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirdan oldin biror narsani qilish.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new sport.
cards.exUz: Yangi sport turida ishlarni o'rganishga vaqt ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi faoliyat yoki ishning asosiy qoidalarini o'rganish.

cards.ex: Joining the team was a no-brainer; it was a great opportunity.
cards.exUz: Jamoaga qo'shilish oson qaror edi; bu ajoyib imkoniyat edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson va aniq qaror, uzoq o'ylashga hojat yo'q.

cards.ex: If you want to win, you need to step up your game.
cards.exUz: Agar g'alaba qozonmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'yiningizni kuchaytirishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ko'proq harakat qilish, sifatni oshirish.

cards.ex: He's really on his game today; he's playing incredibly well.
cards.exUz: U bugun juda tayyor; u juda yaxshi o'ynayapti.
cards.uzDef: O'zining eng yaxshi holatida bo'lish, muvaffaqiyatga tayyor.

cards.ex: The election was down to the wire, with both candidates close in the polls.
cards.exUz: Saylov oxirigacha davom etdi, ikkala nomzodning ovozlari deyarli teng edi.
cards.uzDef: Natija eng oxirigacha aniq bo'lmagan vaziyat.

cards.ex: That competition is way out of my league.
cards.exUz: Bu musobaqa mening darajamdan ancha yuqori.
cards.uzDef: Sizning qobiliyatingiz yoki darajangizdan yuqori bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Launching that product was a home run for the company.
cards.exUz: Ushbu mahsulotni ishga tushirish kompaniya uchun katta muvaffaqiyat bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan katta muvaffaqiyat.

cards.ex: What's the game plan for winning this tournament?
cards.exUz: Ushbu turnirda g'alaba qozonish uchun qanday o'yin rejangiz bor?
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun tuzilgan aniq reja.

cards.ex: I'm going to level with you; your chances of winning are slim.
cards.exUz: Men sizga rostini aytaman; g'alaba qozonish imkoniyatingiz kam.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan ochiq va rost gaplashmoq.

cards.ex: Even though she lost, she was a good sport about it.
cards.exUz: Mag'lub bo'lganiga qaramay, u yaxshi raqib edi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonsa ham, mag'lub bo'lsa ham hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: They keep moving the goalposts, so it's impossible to succeed.
cards.exUz: Ular qoidalarni o'zgartirishda davom etmoqdalar, shuning uchun muvaffaqiyatga erishishning iloji yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarni yoki maqsadlarni o'zgartirish, ayniqsa qiyinchilik tug'diradigan paytda.

cards.ex: After several failed attempts, he finally threw in the towel.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta muvaffaqiyatsiz urinishlardan so'ng, u nihoyat taslim bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Taslim bo'lish, umidni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: It's tough, but we need to stay the course and finish the project.
cards.exUz: Qiyin, lekin biz yo'ldan qaytmasligimiz va loyihani tugatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rejaga sodiq qolish, maqsadga erishish uchun davom etish.
